verdicts.argument: The penalty clause in Pos. 7.1.80 imposes a €5,000 daily fine without any upper limit, which conflicts with the AGB’s stated cap of 0.2–0.3 % per workday.
The net total derived from the VAT line (€988,913.89) does not match the sum of the listed positions (€970,162.89), indicating inconsistent calculations.
The printed subtotal for section 4.1 (€48,647.30) differs from the sum of its positions (€29,896.30), showing a discrepancy of €18,751.00.
The lack of a short or long text for Pos. 4.1.60 leaves the scope undefined, but no document provides a contrary description.
The short text for Pos. 4.1.10 is truncated, yet no other text clarifies the intended item.
The unit “t” for “Schotterstraße wiederherstellen” does not correspond to the nature of the work, and no specification corrects this.
The calculated amount (50 × €10 = €500) does not match the listed gross price of €25, indicating a clear arithmetic error.
Pos. 4.1.50 lacks any description, and no other document supplies the missing details.
Pos. 4.1.70 is similarly undocumented, with no supplementary text to define the scope.
The unit “m²” for a spundwand profile is inappropriate, and the tender documents do not provide a corrective unit.
The unit price of €5.00 / St for traffic sign removal is far below the median of €24.00 / St from comparable past projects, suggesting a pricing error.
The description “Radlader ca. 2,0 m³” is vague, but the tender does not contain a precise definition to refute the bidder’s concern.
